confirmed.item: Offline count chip — Korean toast in English chrome
confirmed.evidence: 오프라인 상태줄 탭 피드백이 한국어(`toast('오프라인 저장: 최근 ${next}개 받는 중…')`, line 110; `toast('오프라인 저장 끔')`, line 111). 반면 같은 기능의 완료 토스트는 영어(offline.js:172 `Offline: N episodes ready`), 상태줄 문구도 전부 영어(line 89-96), 검색 placeholder도 영어(line 51). 라이브러리=홈 크롬은 영어 규칙 위반이며 한 기능 안에서 언어가 섞임.
confirmed.fix: 두 토스트를 영어로 통일 (예: `Saving latest ${next} for offline…` / `Offline downloads off`). 학습 카피가 아니라 크롬 피드백이므로 영어.
confirmed.impact: 운전 중/일상 사용 시 영어 UI 흐름에 한국어 토스트가 튀어 일관성 저하
confirmed.verifyNote: timeline.js:110 `toast(\`오프라인 저장: 최근 ${next}개 받는 중…\`)` 및 :111 `toast('오프라인 저장 끔')` 두 토스트만 한국어. 같은 markOfflineReady 함수 내 상태줄 문구는 전부 영어(:89 `⬇ ${ready.size} episodes available offline`, :91 `⬇ Offline: ${ready.size}/${target} ready`, :92 `downloading…`, :96 `⬇ Offline downloads off · tap to enable`), 검색 placeholder도 영어(:51 `🔍 Search episodes`), 오프라인 배너도 영어(:47). 한 기능 안에서 언어 혼재 확정 — 크롬 피드백이므로 영어 통일이 맞음.

confirmed.item: Offline status line — sub-44px tap target & only offline control
confirmed.evidence: 오프라인 다운로드를 켜고/개수 조절하는 유일한 UI가 `#lib-offline` 텍스트 한 줄을 role=button 으로 만든 것(line 98-104). CSS는 font 12px, min-height 15px, padding 없음(style.css:452). 44px 터치 타깃 크게 미달 — 운전 중 히트 거의 불가. 게다가 오프라인 청취를 준비하는 유일한 진입점이라 발견성도 낮음('⬇ Offline downloads off · tap to enable' 회색 소문)
confirmed.fix: 상태줄에 실제 버튼 크기(min-height 44px + padding) 부여하거나, 오프라인 켜기/개수를 별도 버튼·설정행으로 승격
confirmed.impact: 오프라인 대비(무신호 통근)라는 핵심 시나리오의 진입 컨트롤이 사실상 조작 불가
confirmed.verifyNote: 확정. timeline.js:277에서 #lib-offline div가 유일 오프라인 UI, timeline.js:98-115에서 .tappable+role=button+click 순환(0/5/15/30)이 오프라인 켜는 유일 진입점(setOfflineCount 호출은 timeline.js:109 단 한 곳, 설정 등 대체 없음 grep 확인). style.css:452 .library-offline font 12px/min-height 15px/padding 없음, style.css:454 .tappable은 cursor만 추가하고 크기 미확대 → 실제 탭 타깃 15px로 44px 크게 미달. 텍스트도 회색 소문('⬇ Offline downloads off · tap to enable') 발견성 낮음.

confirmed.item: Offline count cycle — 30→0 wraps to OFF (footgun)
confirmed.evidence: CYCLE=[0,5,15,30](line 106). 30에서 한 번 더 탭하면 next=CYCLE[0]=0 → 오프라인 저장 전면 OFF(setOfflineCount(0), line 109). '더 받으려고' 탭한 사용자가 무심코 전부 끄게 되고, 피드백은 한국어 토스트 한 줄뿐. 확인 다이얼로그·현재값 표시 없음.
confirmed.fix: 30에서 멈추게 하거나(래핑 제거) 명시적 선택 UI로 교체. 현재 개수를 상태줄에 항상 표기해 다음 탭 결과를 예측 가능하게.
confirmed.impact: 모르는 사이 오프라인 다운로드가 꺼져 통근 중 재생 불가로 이어질 수 있음
confirmed.verifyNote: 확정. ui/views/timeline.js:106 CYCLE=[0,5,15,30], line 107-109: 현재값 30이면 i=3, next=(3+1)%4=0 → setOfflineCount(0), line 111 toast('오프라인 저장 끔')로 오프라인 저장 전면 OFF 래핑. 확인 다이얼로그·다음-탭 예고 없이 토스트 한 줄뿐(line 110-111). 다만 주장의 '현재값 표시 없음'은 부정확 — line 91에서 상태줄에 'Offline: N/target ready'로 현재 목표 개수는 항상 표기됨. 그럼에도 30→0 래핑 footgun과 부실한 피드백은 실제 UX 결함으로 확정(partial 등급 적정).

confirmed.item: Empty state — 'sync the RSS feed' copy is misleading
confirmed.evidence: 빈 라이브러리 안내: 'Tap the ↻ button (top right) to sync the RSS feed.'(line 36). 그러나 ↻는 RSS를 당기지 않음 — app.js:252-253 refreshData는 route()로 현재 뷰(listEpisodes=Supabase 재조회)만 재실행하고, 신규 에피소드는 GitHub Actions cron이 Supabase에 채운다(app.js:237 주석). DB가 실제로 비어 있으면 ↻는 스피너+'Synced to latest' 토스트만 띄우고 여전히 빈 화면.
confirmed.fix: 문구를 실제 동작에 맞게 수정('Pull to refresh' 수준) 또는 에피소드 적재가 자동/서버측임을 안내. RSS 동기화를 약속하지 말 것.
confirmed.impact: 진짜 빈 상태의 신규 사용자가 존재하지 않는 액션을 반복해도 아무 변화 없어 막힘
confirmed.verifyNote: 확정. ui/views/timeline.js:36 빈 상태 문구 'Tap the ↻ button (top right) to sync the RSS feed.'가 오도. ui/app.js:237 주석대로 신규 에피소드는 GitHub Actions cron이 Supabase에 채우며, ui/app.js:241-253 refreshData()는 route()로 현재 뷰만 재조회(RSS 당기는 경로 없음) 후 'Synced to latest' 토스트(247)만 표시. DB가 실제 비어 있으면 ↻는 스피너+토스트만 뜨고 화면은 여전히 빔. 문구-동작 불일치 실재.

confirmed.item: Vocabulary 리스트 — 학습 액션 없음 (알아요/리뷰 담기)
confirmed.evidence: vocabHtml (episode.js:1631-1647) 은 term + ▶TTS + kind칩 + definition + example 만 렌더. 인터랙션도 episode.js:1196(.tts speak) / 1202(.ex seek) 두 개뿐. '알아요' 마크 UI 는 style.css:1720 에 존재하지만 Study/SRS 뷰 전용이고 NP 화면 vocab 엔 안 붙는다. ep.vocab 에 known/mastered 상태가 와도 vocabHtml 이 무시해 이미 아는 표현도 동일하게 표시.
confirmed.impact: 데일리 학습이 핵심인 앱인데, 회차 화면에서 뽑아준 표현이 '듣기+예문 시크'로 끝나는 막다른 길. 여기서 바로 리뷰(SRS)에 담거나 '알아요'로 정리를 못 해 학습 루프가 끊긴다.
confirmed.fix: 각 vocab-card 에 44px '알아요'/'리뷰 담기' 토글 추가 — 기존 srs 카드 생성 경로(db.js addToSrs 계열) 재사용, known 이면 카드에 mastered 스타일. 최소한 '알아요' 로컬 마크만이라도 붙여 다음 노출 시 흐리게.
confirmed.verifyNote: 확정. episode.js:1631-1647 vocabHtml 은 kind/example_sentence/term/definition 만 사용, known/mastered 상태 참조 없음. 인터랙션은 episode.js:1196(.tts speak)/1202(.ex seek) 둘뿐 — '알아요'/'리뷰 담기' 학습 액션 부재. ep.vocab 에 known 이 와도 무시되어 아는 표현도 동일 표시됨. missing-feature 유형으로 코드 사실 일치.

confirmed.item: Vocab ▶TTS + 예문 시크 + prefetch — 오디오 미다운로드 회차에서 무반응
confirmed.evidence: Vocabulary 섹션은 audio_url 유무와 무관하게 항상 렌더(episode.js:103-108). 그런데 !ep.audio_url 이면 episode.js:151-153 에서 early-return → .tts/.ex 리스너(1196-1210)와 prefetch(1211)가 전혀 안 붙는다. TTS(speak)는 오디오가 필요 없는데도 ▶ 가 죽는다. audio_url 은 보통 스트리밍 URL이라 흔치 않지만(오프라인 미캐시 회차·audio_url 없는 DB행), 그 상태에서 vocab 발음/예문탭이 조용히 실패.
confirmed.impact: 오디오가 없는 회차 페이지에서 ▶ 발음 버튼과 예문 탭이 눌러도 아무 반응 없는 데드 컨트롤. 발음 듣기는 오디오 없이도 가능해야 하는데 막힘.
confirmed.fix: About 토글처럼 vocab TTS·prefetch 배선을 early-return '앞'으로 이동(오디오 불필요). 예문 시크만 audio_url 가드. 또는 audio 없으면 vocab-card 의 ▶ 는 유지하되 .ex 시크는 비활성 표시.
confirmed.verifyNote: 확정. Vocabulary는 audio_url과 무관하게 렌더(episode.js:103-108), 그러나 !ep.audio_url이면 episode.js:151-153에서 early-return. vocab TTS(speak, 오디오 불필요) 리스너·예문 시크·prefetch가 episode.js:1196-1211에 early-return '뒤'에 있어 미배선. About 토글(134-149)은 이미 early-return 앞으로 이동해 있어(동일 취지 주석 포함) vocab만 누락된 것이 대조로 확인됨. line 92 'audio not downloaded yet' 빈 상태가 !audio_url 도달 가능성을 뒷받침. 제안 수리(TTS/prefetch 배선을 early-return 앞으로 이동, 예문 시크만 audio_url 가드) 타당.

confirmed.item: Practice → Quiz / Weak quiz (read mode) auto-speaks the answer
confirmed.evidence: paintQ() runs `requestAnimationFrame(() => speak(c.term))` unconditionally for BOTH modes. In 'read' mode the def is shown and the options are the terms, so auto-speaking c.term (the correct answer) tells the user exactly which written option to pick. It also makes the '🔊 힌트' button (line 1056) redundant — the hint is forced, not optional. Weak quiz (startWeakQuiz→startQuiz('read')) and the session 'Speed quiz' drill (AXIS_DRILL.automaticity='read') inherit this.
confirmed.impact: Flagship recall quiz is trivialised (answer read aloud); the automaticity axis is systematically inflated on both accuracy and latency (recordMeasure at line 1090), directly undermining the app's 'honest measurement' framing.
confirmed.fix: Gate the auto-play to listen mode only: `if (mode==='listen') requestAnimationFrame(()=>speak(c.term));` and keep the manual '🔊 힌트' button for read/weak.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. study.js:1066 `requestAnimationFrame(() => speak(c.term))` runs unconditionally in paintQ() for both modes. In read mode: line 1055 shows the definition (`quiz-def`), line 1051/1062 render options as terms (`o.term`), and c.term is the correct answer — so auto-speaking it reveals which written option is correct, forcing the '🔊 힌트' button (line 1056). read-mode quizzes (startWeakQuiz→'read', AXIS_DRILL automaticity='read') inherit this via the same paintQ. Suggested gate `if(mode==='listen')` is valid.

confirmed.item: Today card → Daily session (Start while offline)
confirmed.evidence: startSession does `try{queue=await srsQueue()}catch{queue=[]}` (line 799). Offline → queue=[] → sessReview/sessNew both skip (empty) → sessDrill: `allExpressions()` throws → all=[] → pool empty → `return sessSummary(st)`. sessSummary unconditionally sets `st.stage='done'; st.completedAt=Date.now()` (lines 947-948) even though `worked` is false. heroHtml then renders '✓ Session complete' / '▶ One more' (lines 302,318).
confirmed.impact: A subway/driving offline tap on Start instantly marks today's session complete with zero work done; when back online the user sees 'Session complete' and may skip studying. (Streak is safe — markStudyDay is worked-gated — but the completion STATE is wrong.)
confirmed.fix: Only set completedAt/'done' when `worked` is true; otherwise leave the session resumable and render an offline/empty state ('couldn't load your queue — try again when online') instead of a completed summary.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. study.js:799 offline→queue=[]; sessReview(824-825)/sessNew(874-875) skip on empty; sessDrill(918,926-927) all=[]→pool empty→return sessSummary; sessSummary(947-948) unconditionally sets st.stage='done' + st.completedAt=Date.now() — the worked flag (951-952) only gates markStudyDay/streak, not the completed state. heroHtml then renders '✓ Session complete'/(301) and '▶ One more'/(317) for a session where nothing happened. Claim's cited 302/318 are off-by-one (actual completed-state strings at 301/317) but behavior is exact. Real UX bug.

confirmed.evidence: loadKind() calls `paintShell()` (full `root.innerHTML = heroHtml()+…+statsHtml()`, line 733) on every chip tap just to move the `.on` highlight, then re-renders #study-list. This re-runs paintDrive() (re-fetches getEpisode for any marks), collapses the Practice and My-stats `<details>` (no `open` attr), and resets scroll to the hero.
confirmed.impact: Browsing expressions by kind — a core Study interaction — jumps the page back to the top, collapses expanded panels, and refires network on each tap.
confirmed.fix: On kind switch, only toggle `.study-kind-chip.on` classes + re-render #study-list (host innerHTML + wireList); don't rebuild the whole shell or repaint Drive.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. study.js:1015 loadKind() calls paintShell(), which at :733 does full root.innerHTML=heroHtml()+study-list+statsHtml() and at :734 calls paintDrive() (re-fetches getEpisode per mark at :656-657). Both Practice (:330) and My-stats (:366) <details> lack an `open` attr so they collapse to closed on every chip tap, and the wholesale innerHTML rebuild resets scroll to the hero. The .on highlight only needs a class toggle on .study-kind-chip (wired :735) + #study-list re-render, so the full shell repaint is genuinely unnecessary. Real UX regression.

confirmed.item: Essentials list swipe → Known: header progress stays stale
confirmed.evidence: wireSwipe pointerup (essentials.js:144-145) calls setKnown() + li.classList.add('known') but never re-renders the header progress. overview() computes masteredAll/pct/ess-play count only once (essentials.js:52-80). Swiping several list cards to Known updates localStorage and the row checkmark, yet the top bar 'N / 256 mastered · X%' (essentials.js:63) and the '🃏 Study N new cards' button label (essentials.js:76-80) do not move until you switch category or leave and re-enter.
confirmed.fix: After a successful setKnown() in wireSwipe, patch the aggregate in place: recompute masteredAll and update .ess-prog-bar span width + .ess-prog-meta text (and optionally the #ess-play label). Cheapest correct fix: call a small refreshProgress() that re-reads knownSet() and writes those two nodes, rather than a full overview() re-render (which would rebuild the list and cancel the swipe animation).
confirmed.impact: Daily-learning feedback loop feels broken: the user marks a batch Known but the mastery %/count they are trying to grow appears frozen, undercutting the core motivation signal.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. essentials.js:144 wireSwipe pointerup calls setKnown()+li.classList.add('known') only; header progress (ess-prog-bar/ess-prog-meta at :62-63) and #ess-play label (:76-80) are computed once in overview() (:51-88). paintList() (:90-119) only rewrites #ess-list, which does not contain those header/play nodes. overview() re-renders only on category (:83) or dir (:84) clicks, so swiping list cards to Known updates localStorage + row checkmark but leaves the 'N / 256 mastered · X%' bar and 'Study N new cards' button stale until category switch or re-entry.

confirmed.item: SRS review screen: no offline / load-failure state (queue fetch)
confirmed.evidence: renderSrs awaits srsQueue() with no try/catch (srs.js:43). srsQueue() hits Supabase (db.js:343-360) and throws on network failure, so offline the whole Review tab falls through to the generic router catch ('Something went wrong / Retry', app.js:51-58). This is inconsistent with the same file's honest offline handling on grading (srs.js:242-245 toasts '오프라인 — 저장되지 않았어요'), and with the app's offline-listening positioning. The empty-queue branch (srs.js:44-53) only covers a successful empty fetch, never the offline case.
confirmed.fix: Wrap srsQueue() in try/catch; on failure with !navigator.onLine render an offline-specific card ('오프라인 — 복습 큐를 불러올 수 없어요', with a retry button that re-runs renderSrs on 'online' event), otherwise a generic retry. Distinguish the two so an offline user isn't told the app is 'broken'.
confirmed.impact: Reviewing offline (e.g. commuting without signal) shows a generic error, not the honest offline messaging the rest of the flow provides.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. srs.js:43 `const initial = await srsQueue();` has no try/catch. srsQueue() (db.js:343-360) queries Supabase and throws on error (db.js:357-358 `throw new Error(...)`); a network failure rejects the promise. renderSrs is invoked from the router at app.js:50 inside try/catch, so the rejection falls through to the generic catch at app.js:51-58 rendering 'Something went wrong. / Retry'. The empty-queue branch (srs.js:44-53) only fires on a successful empty fetch (`!initial.length`), never on the offline throw. This is inconsistent with the same file's honest offline handling on grading (srs.js:240-245: `if (!navigator.onLine) toast('오프라인 — 이 복습 결과는 저장되지 않았어요')`). Offline users opening the Review tab are told the app is broken. Real, medium/partial UX gap.

confirmed.item: Essentials study copy is English (convention is Korean study copy)
confirmed.evidence: Like srs.js, the Essentials learning microcopy is English while study.js uses Korean: list tip 'Tap for audio · KR for meaning · swipe → Known' (essentials.js:95), CTA 'Study N new cards' / 'Review N cards' (essentials.js:79), 'Show answer' / 'Show meaning' (essentials.js:215), 'Swipe → Known · ← Again (repeats)' (essentials.js:218), summary 'Flawless deck! 🌟' / 'Deck cleared! 🃏' + 'Play again' / 'Essentials Home' (essentials.js:167-175). Only the subtitle '미국 현지·비즈니스 핵심표현' (essentials.js:59) and the direction glosses '인식/말하기' (essentials.js:73-74) are Korean, making the mix look accidental rather than intentional.
confirmed.fix: Localize instructional strings to Korean (e.g. '탭 → 발음 · KR → 뜻 · 오른쪽 스와이프 → Known', '새 카드 N개 학습', '정답 보기'/'뜻 보기', '오른쪽 → Known · 왼쪽 → 다시', '완벽해요!'/'덱 완료!'). Keep Known/Essentials tokens English to match study.js.
confirmed.impact: Second study surface reinforces the same register inconsistency; direction toggle glosses in Korean next to English CTAs read as half-translated.
confirmed.verifyNote: Genuine intra-app inconsistency confirmed: essentials.js startGame card-game copy is English where study.js's parallel Sentences card game (startSentences) uses Korean for the exact same functions — '완벽했어요!/덱 완료!' (study.js:1146) vs 'Flawless deck!/Deck cleared!' (essentials.js:167), '마스터·N회 반복' (study.js:1151) vs 'mastered·N repeats' (essentials.js:172), '다시 하기/홈으로' (study.js:1153-1154) vs 'Play again/Essentials Home' (essentials.js:174-175), '뜻 보기' (study.js:1194) vs 'Show meaning' (essentials.js:215), '밀기 → 알아요 · ← 다시(반복)' (study.js:1197) vs 'Swipe → Known · ← Again (repeats)' (essentials.js:218). Caveat: the finding's cited anchor (essentials.js:95 list tip) is actually consistent — study.js:435 list tip is ALSO English — so the 'accidental mix' framing at line 95 misfires, but the card-game strings are a real, low-severity i18n inconsistency and the suggested Korean localization is sound.

confirmed.item: SRS audio replay / context buttons below 44px touch target
confirmed.evidence: .srs-listen-btn is width:38px;height:38px (style.css:1337) — the primary 🔊 replay control shown at stage≥1 (srs.js:125). .srs-context-btn ('🎧 Hear in context', srs.js:136) is padding:8px 16px with 12.5px font (style.css:1961-1966) → ~30px tall. Both are core audio actions for shadowing yet sit under the 44px minimum used elsewhere (e.g. .ess-back is 44×44, style.css:1899).
confirmed.fix: Bump .srs-listen-btn to 44×44 (or add padding to reach 44px hit area) and give .srs-context-btn min-height:44px. These are the buttons a user taps to re-hear audio during hands-busy shadowing.
confirmed.impact: Frequent re-listen taps are easy to miss on a phone, especially the small round 38px replay button during shadowing.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. ui/style.css:1337 `.srs-listen-btn { width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50% }` — the 🔊 replay button rendered at stage>=1 (ui/views/srs.js:125, id=tts-btn, aria-label Replay audio). ui/style.css:1961-1966 `.srs-context-btn { font-size:12.5px; padding:8px 16px }` → ~33px tall (8+8 padding + ~17px line) — the '🎧 Hear in context' button at stage===2 (srs.js:136). Both are core audio-replay controls yet fall below the 44px min the same file uses for `.ess-back` (44x44, style.css:1899). Real touch-target inconsistency affecting hands-busy shadowing use.

confirmed.item: Settings/Account surface (no menu) — hidden logout + scattered prefs
confirmed.evidence: The ONLY logout affordance is a 700ms long-press on the ↻ sync button (app.js:261-263 pointerdown → signOut). Nothing labels or hints this. Other prefs are scattered with no home: theme = topbar toggle; offline-count 0/5/15/30 = an obscure tap-cycle on the Library bottom status line (timeline.js:105-115); font size = episode-scoped control (episode.js:893); session size = Study knob (study.js:35). The 2-tab IA (Library/Study, index.html:97-100) has no Settings/Account tab at all.
confirmed.fix: Add a lightweight Settings/Account surface (e.g. gear in topbar, or make the version pill open it) consolidating: Sign out (visible), Offline downloads N, Theme (incl. Auto), reading font size. At minimum expose a visible Sign-out — a hidden long-press is undiscoverable and also risks accidental logout while reaching for Sync.
confirmed.impact: User cannot find how to sign out; account switching and offline/theme prefs are effectively hidden gestures. Long-press could log out accidentally.
confirmed.verifyNote: Claim confirmed. Only logout affordance is a 700ms long-press on the sync button: app.js:260-263 ($sync pointerdown → setTimeout 700 → signOut). No label/hint exists. IA is 2-tab only (index.html:98-100 Library/Study), no Settings/Account tab. Topbar has just a version span (#app-version index.html:67) and a theme toggle (#theme-btn index.html:68) — no settings/gear anywhere (grep for settings|gear|account|⚙ returns nothing). Offline count 0/5/15/30 is an obscure tap-cycle on the Library status line (timeline.js:105-116, CYCLE=[0,5,15,30]). Session size is a Study-scoped knob (study.js:35 SESS_SIZE_KEY). Prefs are genuinely scattered with no home. Minor mitigation: signOut() has a confirm('Log out?') dialog (app.js:256), so a stray long-press is not a silent one-tap logout — but discoverability of the sign-out affordance itself remains the real, unaddressed problem. Finding is real.

confirmed.item: Review tab (#/srs) — no active tab highlight, no back button
confirmed.evidence: Route srs declares tab:'srs', back:false (app.js:27), but the tabbar only has data-tab='timeline' and 'study' (index.html:98-99). In route() the loop sets aria-current only on a[data-tab===r.tab] and removes it from all others (app.js:38-41), so on #/srs NEITHER Library nor Study is highlighted and no back button shows. Review is entered from Study (study.js:322 href='#/srs') but presents as an orphan screen; the only way back is tapping the un-highlighted Study tab.
confirmed.fix: Set the srs route's tab to 'study' (it is part of the study flow) so the Study tab stays lit while reviewing, or give it back:true. Either gives the user a wayfinding cue / explicit exit.
confirmed.impact: In Review the user loses the 'where am I' cue and has no obvious way back — poor during quick daily review.
confirmed.verifyNote: app.js:27 srs route declares tab:'srs', back:false. index.html:98-99 tabbar only contains data-tab='timeline' and 'study' (no 'srs'). app.js:38-41 assigns aria-current only to a[data-tab===r.tab]; since no tab equals 'srs', neither Library nor Study is highlighted on #/srs, and $back.hidden=!r.back hides the back button. Result: orphan Review screen with no wayfinding cue. Confirmed.

confirmed.item: Invalid episode id → generic error with looping Retry
confirmed.evidence: Route regex /episode/(\d+) matches any numeric id, so #/episode/999999 is treated as valid. renderEpisode → getEpisode calls .single() which throws on no rows (db.js:135 'if (error) throw'). route() catches it and renders 'Something went wrong / Retry' (app.js:51-57). Retry just re-runs route() → getEpisode throws again → same screen. The error card has no 'Back to Library' affordance (only Retry).
confirmed.fix: Detect the not-found case (empty single() result) and show a specific 'Episode not found' state with a Library link, and/or validate the id against the episode list before rendering. Add a Home link to the generic error card so Retry isn't the only exit.
confirmed.impact: A shared/stale episode link, or a deleted episode, drops the user into a dead-end Retry loop.
confirmed.verifyNote: 확정. 라우트 regex가 임의 숫자 id 매칭(ui/app.js:25). getEpisode가 .single() 사용, 0행 시 PostgREST가 PGRST116 error 반환 → throw(ui/db.js:133-134, 주장의 db.js:135는 실제 134로 오프바이원). route()가 catch해 generic 'Something went wrong / Retry' 카드 렌더(ui/app.js:51-57), Retry는 route() 재실행이라 getEpisode가 다시 throw → 동일 화면 루프. 에러 카드 내부엔 Retry만 있고 Library/Home 링크 없음(ui/app.js:53-56). 부분 반박: 헤더 back 버튼(ui/index.html:62 + 핸들러 ui/app.js:235 history.back())이 episode 라우트 back:true로 에러 시에도 표시되어 앱 헤더 레벨의 탈출구는 존재 → 'Retry가 유일 탈출'은 카드 한정으로만 참이며 severity는 medium/partial 수준으로 완화. 전용 not-found 처리 부재라는 핵심은 사실.

confirmed.item: Theme toggle permanently discards the Auto (system) default
confirmed.evidence: Default theme is auto/system (effectiveTheme reads localStorage else matchMedia, app.js:272-275). The toggle only cycles light↔dark and always writes an explicit value (app.js:285-289). Once written, the _mql 'change' listener no-ops (app.js:293-295 only runs when saved is not light/dark), so the app stops following the OS Night-Shift/auto-dark and there is NO in-app way to return to Auto (no Settings, no long-press reset).
confirmed.fix: Make the control tri-state (Auto → Light → Dark) or add 'Follow system' in a Settings surface / long-press to clear aep-theme. Keep syncing theme-color meta from the OS while in Auto.
confirmed.impact: After one tap the app no longer tracks the phone's day/night theme, which matters for a driving/night-use app; user is stuck unless they clear site data.
confirmed.verifyNote: Confirmed. Default is auto: effectiveTheme() reads localStorage else matchMedia (ui/app.js:271-275); init passes 'auto' (app.js:291). Toggle only cycles light↔dark and always writes an explicit value (app.js:285-289). _mql 'change' listener no-ops once an explicit value is saved (app.js:293-295 guards saved!==light/dark). grep across ui/ finds NO removeItem('aep-theme'), no Settings surface, and no long-press on #theme-btn (only $sync has a 700ms hold, app.js:261-266). So Auto is unreachable after any toggle. medium/partial severity is fair — cosmetic (stops following OS Night-Shift), no data/functional loss.

critic.item: Drive capture — 차/잠금화면 ⏭(nexttrack) 오버라이드가 에피소드 이탈 후에도 유지 (cross-surface)
critic.evidence: marks.js:183 applyDriveMS() 가 nexttrack 핸들러를 addMark 로 덮어씀(setDrive→applyDriveMS, 187-191). setDrive(false) 는 오직 initDriveCapture(=에피소드 진입, marks.js:200)에서만 호출됨. episode.js:1155-1174 teardown 은 off()/offWord()/txScrub.destroy 등 다수 리스너를 정리하지만 setDrive(false) 는 없음 → Drive ON 상태로 Library/Study/Review 탭으로 이동하면 미니플레이어 재생은 계속되는데 차 핸들/잠금화면 ⏭ 는 +30s 스킵 대신 조용히 북마크(addMark)만 저장. 다음 에피소드 재진입(initDriveCapture) 전까지 이 상태가 지속됨.
critic.impact: 운전 중 잠금화면/테슬라 ⏭ 로 빨리감기하려는데 아무 반응(스킵) 없이 마크만 쌓임 — 정확히 이 앱이 최우선으로 삼는 '운전 중 재생 조작' 실패
critic.fix: episode.js hashchange teardown(1155~) 및 popstate 경로에서 setDrive(false) 호출; 또는 marks.js 에 라우트-이탈 리셋 훅 추가(body 에서 on-episode 제거될 때 setDrive(false))로 nexttrack 을 +30s 로 복원.

critic.item: 전역 재생-실패 / 비보안 안내 토스트 — 영어 크롬에 한국어
critic.evidence: player.js:93 toast(navigator.onLine ? '재생 실패 — 다시 시도해 주세요' : '오프라인에선 ⬇ 받은 회차만 재생돼요') — 미니플레이어·잠금화면·차량 등 어느 화면에서든 뜨는 핵심 재생 피드백. app.js:416 'http 접속이라 음성은 브라우저 기본음으로 재생돼요 · https·설치앱 권장' 도 동일 경로. 규칙(홈/플레이어 크롬=영어, 학습 카피만 한국어)에 반함. audit 는 라이브러리 offline 토스트·About 라벨만 지적했고 이 전역 플레이어 피드백 경로는 미감사.
critic.impact: 차/잠금화면에서 재생 실패 시 뜨는 유일한 안내가 크롬 규칙을 깨는 한국어 — 표기 일관성 붕괴
critic.fix: 세 문자열을 영어로: 'Playback failed — try again' / 'Offline — only downloaded (⬇) episodes play' / insecure hint 영문화. 학습(Study) 카피의 한국어와 구분해 크롬은 영어 통일.

critic.item: Sync ↻ — 리뷰/세션 진행 중 탭하면 조용히 처음으로 리셋 (데이터 손실)
critic.evidence: app.js:241-254 refreshData(): /^#\/episode\// 해시만 재라우팅에서 제외(252). #/srs·#/study 는 Promise.resolve(route()) 실행 → renderSrs/renderStudy 가 큐를 새로 fetch 하고 처음부터 렌더 → SRS 복습 도중이면 현재 카드/진행 위치가 유실되고 due 큐 첫 카드로 되돌아감. topbar sync 버튼은 리뷰 중에도 항상 보이므로 오탭 가능. audit 의 sync 항목은 '에피소드에서 no-op' 만 다뤄 이 리셋 footgun 은 미감사.
critic.impact: 복습 세션 중 ↻ 를 실수로 누르면 진행이 사라지고 큐 첫 카드로 리셋 — 매일 학습 흐름 파괴
critic.fix: 리뷰/세션 활성 상태 가드 추가: 활성이면 재라우팅 대신 'Synced' 토스트만(episode 처럼) 또는 확인 프롬프트. 최소한 #/srs 진행 중엔 route() 재실행 금지.

critic.evidence: index.html:84-89 지속형 미니플레이어는 재생/일시정지(mp-play) + ⏭ +30s(mp-fwd, player.js:219 skip(30)) 만 제공. −15s 되감기 버튼 없음. 놓친 구절을 되감으려면 풀 에피소드 화면을 열어야 함(운전 중 위험). media-session.js:28 은 차/잠금화면용 previoustrack(-15) 을 제공하는데, 정작 화면 미니플레이어에는 대칭 컨트롤이 없어 표면 간 비대칭.
critic.impact: 운전 중 방금 놓친 문장을 미니플레이어에서 되감을 수 없어 전체 화면 진입을 강요 — 쉐도잉 특성상 되감기가 앞으로가기보다 자주 필요
critic.fix: 미니플레이어에 mp-back(−15s) 버튼 추가해 −15/+30 대칭, 또는 진행바 좌측 영역 탭=되감기 매핑.

critic.item: 오프라인 — 특정 회차 수동 다운로드 수단 없음 ('audio not downloaded yet' 막다른 안내)
critic.evidence:
episode.js:92 오디오가 캐시되지 않은 회차는 transport 컨트롤 대신 '
audio not downloaded yet
' 만 렌더 — 다운로드 버튼/액션이 전혀 없음. 오프라인 캐시는 offline.js ensureOfflineCache 가 자동으로 hostedSet 중 최근 N개만 받음(119). 통근을 위해 특정 옛 회차를 미리 확보하는 유일한 통로는 Library 상태줄의 전역 개수 조절뿐 — 회차 단위 pin 불가.
critic.impact: 운전 통근 전 원하는 특정 회차의 오프라인 확보 불가; 미캐시 회차 화면은 아무 조치도 못 하는 막다른 길
critic.fix: episode.js 미캐시 상태에 온라인일 때 'Download for offline' 원탭 버튼 → offline.js cacheAudio(hostedAudioUrl(id)) 호출 + 진행/완료 피드백. 자동 N개와 별개로 사용자 pin 세트 유지.

critic.item: 잠금화면·차량 디스플레이 메타데이터가 'American English Podcast' (앱 브랜드 E-Podcast 와 불일치)
critic.evidence: media-session.js:13 const SHOW='American English Podcast'; buildMetadata 가 artist=track.show||SHOW, album=SHOW(39-44) 로 사용 → 잠금화면·테슬라 화면(운전 중 가장 오래 보는 표면)에 옛 쇼명이 뜸. 앱은 E-Podcast 로 리브랜드(index.html:13 title, manifest, page-title). audit 는 로그인 화면 타이틀만 지적했고, 이 media-session(차/잠금화면) 표면은 별도 파일·미감사. 브랜드 소스가 login.js:23·media-session.js:13·config 3곳으로 분산.
critic.impact: 운전/잠금화면에서 보이는 브랜드가 앱과 달라 정체성 혼란; 로그인 타이틀만 고쳐도 이 표면은 그대로 남음
critic.fix: config.js 의 단일 브랜드/쇼 상수로 통일해 login 타이틀·media-session SHOW·manifest 가 같은 값을 참조. 멀티쇼면 track.show 를 우선하고 SHOW 는 폴백으로만.

lows.item: Show switcher — tablist role misuse + Korean aria-label
lows.evidence: 쇼 선택기가 role=tablist/role=tab(line 178-186)인데 실제로는 tabpanel 관계 없이 탭 시 renderTimeline로 전체 화면을 재렌더(네비게이션). SR에게 tab 의미가 오도됨. 추가로 `aria-label="팟캐스트 선택"`(line 186)은 영어 크롬 안의 한국어 라벨.
lows.fix: role을 radiogroup/radio 또는 일반 버튼 그룹으로, aria-label은 영어('Choose podcast')로.
lows.impact: 스크린리더 사용자에게 잘못된 위젯 의미 + 언어 규칙 위반

lows.item: Episode search — clearing box loses season collapse state
lows.evidence: 검색 입력 핸들러는 쿼리가 비어도 `groupsHtml(filtered, true)`(openAll=true, line 70)로 렌더 → 검색 후 지우면 기본(최신 시즌만 펼침)이 아니라 모든 시즌이 펼쳐진 상태로 남음. 최초 렌더의 접힘 기본값 상실.
lows.fix: q가 빈 경우 openAll=false로 렌더(또는 초기 groupsHtml 마크업 복원)
lows.impact: 검색을 한 번 쓰면 시즌 접힘 UX가 리셋돼 긴 목록이 다시 다 펼쳐짐

lows.item: Offline status tap while offline — 'downloading' toast but no-op
lows.evidence: 오프라인 상태에서도 상태줄이 tappable이라 탭 시 '…받는 중…' 토스트+forceRun 실행(line 110). 그러나 forceRun→ensureOfflineCache는 `if (!navigator.onLine) return`(offline.js:97)로 즉시 반환 → 실제 다운로드 0. 오프라인 특정 상태에서 조용히 실패하며 오해 유발.
lows.fix: 오프라인일 때 탭 비활성화하거나 '오프라인에선 받을 수 없어요' 안내로 분기
lows.impact: 무신호 상황에서 사용자가 '받는 중'으로 오인하고 대기

lows.item: Logout — only via undocumented 700ms long-press on ↻
lows.evidence: 로그아웃 진입점이 sync 버튼 700ms 롱프레스 하나뿐(app.js:261-263 pointerdown 타이머→signOut). 시각적 표식 전무(aria-label='Sync'만). '확실히 새로고침'하려 길게 눌러도 로그아웃 confirm이 뜸.
lows.fix: 메뉴/설정에 보이는 Sign out 추가하거나 최소한 롱프레스 동작을 힌트로 노출. refresh와의 오버로드 재검토.
lows.impact: 로그아웃/재로그인이 필요한 상황(계정 문제 등)에서 방법을 찾기 어려움

lows.item: About 더보기/접기 — 영어 크롬에 한국어 라벨
lows.evidence: np-about-toggle 초기 텍스트 '더보기'(episode.js:99), syncToggle 이 '접기'/'더보기'로 갱신(episode.js:143). 같은 About 블록의 헤딩은 'About'(영어), 주변 NP 크롬도 전부 영어(Transcript, Shadow, Back 15s…). 언어 규칙(플레이어 크롬=영어) 위반.
lows.impact: 플레이어 화면에서 영/한이 섞여 마감이 덜 된 인상. 규칙상 크롬은 영어 통일 대상.
lows.fix: '더보기'→'More', '접기'→'Less' (또는 'Show more'/'Show less').

lows.item: 시트 툴바 6칩(KR/가/Shadow/1×/A/🚗) — 터치 타깃 ~29px
lows.evidence: .tx-toggle padding:7px 13px · font 12.5px (style.css:995-999) → 높이 ≈29px. tx-drive 는 20px SVG라도 ~34px. transcript 시트 툴바(episode.js:1407-1414)의 6칩 전부 44px 미만. 반면 시트 트랜스포트(.tx-mini-btn 46px, style.css:752)와 NP 트랜스포트(.np-ctrl-btn 8px패딩+34px SVG≈50px)는 충족.
lows.impact: 쉐도잉 중(차 안 곁눈질 포함) 자주 만지는 KR/속도/Shadow/드라이브 칩이 작아 오탭 유발. 44px 가이드 미달.
lows.fix: tx-toggle 최소 높이 44px(min-height 또는 세로 패딩 상향), 시각 크기는 유지하되 히트 영역만 확장.

lows.item: 스크러버·글자크기 a11y 라벨 — 한국어 혼재
lows.evidence: np-scrub aria-label='탐색'(episode.js:69) — 같은 화면의 다른 aria-label 은 전부 영어(Restart/previous episode, Back 15s, Play/Pause, Forward 30s, Next episode). 시트 tx-fs 는 aria-label='Text size'인데 title='글자 크기'로 툴팁만 한국어(episode.js:1412).
lows.impact: 스크린리더/툴팁에서 영·한 뒤섞임. 크롬 a11y 라벨 언어 규칙 불일치.
lows.fix: aria-label='탐색'→'Seek', title='글자 크기'→'Text size'(aria-label 과 통일).

lows.item: 종료모드 칩(np-endmode) — 아이콘 전용, 상태 식별·피드백 부족
lows.evidence: END_MODES 는 아이콘만(next=스킵글리프, repeat=루프, once=루프+작은 '1'; episode.js:995-999). repeat 와 once 는 20px 안 중앙의 font-size:10 '1' 유무로만 구분. 탭 시 토스트/텍스트 피드백 명시적으로 없음(episode.js:994 주석 '안내 토스트 없음'). 반면 속도칩/Shadow칩은 텍스트('1.5×','5× Auto')로 현재값이 읽힌다.
lows.impact: 운전 중 회차 종료 동작(다음재생/반복/한번만)을 세 개 유사 글리프로만 순환 — 지금 어떤 모드인지 곁눈질로 판별 어렵고 확인 피드백도 없다.
lows.fix: repeat/once 글리프 대비 강화(once='1×' 텍스트 배지 등) 또는 탭 시 짧은 토스트('Autoplay next'/'Repeat'/'Play once'). 최소한 aria-label 을 현재 모드에 맞춰 갱신.

lows.item: 롱프레스 사전 팝오버 — 열린 채 이탈 시 재생 정지 유지
lows.evidence: showWordPop 이 열릴 때 재생 중이면 player.pause() + _lpWasPlaying=true(episode.js:612-613), hideWordPop 이 player.play() 로 복귀(607). 그러나 cleanup(hashchange, episode.js:1167)은 _wpEl.remove()+리스너 제거만 하고 _lpWasPlaying 재생 복귀는 안 한다. 팝오버 열린 상태에서 하드웨어 뒤로가기(pointerdown-outside 없이 popstate) 로 이탈하면 오디오가 정지된 채 남는다.
lows.impact: 드문 경로지만, 단어 뜻 확인 중 뒤로가기 하면 미니플레이어가 멈춘 채로 남아 '왜 안 들리지' 상황.
lows.fix: cleanup 에서 _lpWasPlaying 이면 player.play() 호출(또는 hideWordPop() 를 cleanup 초입에 무조건 호출).

lows.item: Transcript — 자막 있고 오디오 없을 때 접근 불가 + 시트 orphan
lows.evidence: np-tx-btn(Transcript 버튼)은 ${ep.audio_url ? ...} 블록 안에서만 렌더(episode.js:67-92). 반면 시트 빌드는 sentences.length 만 보고 실행돼 $sheet 를 body 에 append(episode.js:117-129). audio_url 이 없고 sentences 는 있으면: 시트는 DOM 에 만들어지지만 여는 버튼이 없어 openSheet 도달 불가 → 트랜스크립트 열람 불가 + 죽은 시트 노드가 cleanup 까지 상주. empty state('transcript pending')는 !sentences 일 때만 떠서 이 상태엔 아무 안내도 없음.
lows.impact: 오디오 없는(미캐시) 회차에서 스크립트가 존재해도 읽을 방법이 없고, 매 렌더마다 시트 DOM 을 만들었다 버린다.
lows.fix: audio_url 없을 땐 시트 빌드를 건너뛰거나, Transcript 버튼을 audio_url 블록 밖으로 빼 오디오 없이도 읽기 전용으로 열 수 있게.

lows.item: Today card → 'Level check ›' link
lows.evidence: Rendered as `<a class="cont-script" id="plan-level" role="button" tabindex="0">` but only a click listener is attached (line 749). Sibling role=button controls wire both click AND keydown Enter/Space: `.prof-axis` (lines 754-755) and `.study-x-ep` (line 525). An `<a>` with no href is not natively keyboard-activatable, so physical-keyboard/AT-keyboard users can focus 'Level check' but cannot trigger it.
lows.impact: Keyboard/desktop AT users can't start a level check; inconsistent with the file's own role=button pattern.
lows.fix: Add a keydown Enter/Space handler (mirror .study-x-ep at line 525) or make it a real `<button>`.

lows.item: Sub-44px touch targets on core driving/daily controls
lows.evidence: Drive triage: `.dm-know,.dm-study{min-height:34px}` (style.css:2389), `.dm-x` Dismiss has only `padding:8px` with negative margins ≈30px (style.css:2357). Today links: `.cont-script` is a 13px inline link with no vertical padding (style.css:298). Drill chips: `.study-x-tr` KR button `height:28px` (style.css:1594), `.dict-slow-btn` '🐢 천천히' padding 7px/12.5px ≈30px (style.css:1738). All below the 44px target the audit calls for.
lows.impact: 'Know it/Learn/Dismiss' (driving-capture triage) and 'Level check/Review' (daily entry) are the exact controls tapped in the glance-while-driving flow, yet are the smallest — fat-finger misses.
lows.fix: Give these controls min-height:44px and expand the hit area (padding), especially the Drive triage buttons and the two Today text links.

lows.item: 'Not enough expressions / no material' empty states
lows.evidence: Same message ships in two languages depending on entry point: Weak quiz = 'Not enough expressions for a quiz (need 4+).' (line 1120) and Level check = 'No material to test yet.' (line 993) in English, but Quiz = '퀴즈를 만들 표현이 부족해요 (4개 이상 필요).' (line 1036), Dictation/Sentences = '예문이 있는 표현이 아직 없어요.' (lines 1135/1309/1395), Cloze = '빈칸 퀴즈용 예문이 아직 없어요.' (line 1743) in Korean — all rendered into the same #study-list slot.
lows.impact: Inconsistent voice for identical situations in the same feature area; the English strings clash with the surrounding Korean learning copy.
lows.fix: Pick one language for these in-list empty states (Korean, matching the learning-copy rule) so the same condition reads the same everywhere.

lows.item: Today card → Level check (unseen-listening measurement)
lows.evidence: startLevelCheck builds `pool = unseen.length>=5 ? unseen : withEx` (line 991) then always calls `startDictation(pool, true)` (line 996) with unseen=true. When the unseen pool is small it falls back to the FULL withEx pool but still records every item as unseen, so already-practiced items feed proficiency's `listeningUnseen` (rawFromLog).
lows.impact: The one feature meant to give an *unbiased* listening score (comment: '외운 게 아닌 실제 청해를 비편향 측정') logs seen items as unseen whenever fewer than 5 fresh items exist, biasing the measure it exists to protect.
lows.fix: When falling back to the full pool, pass unseen=false (or skip recording as unseen) so only genuinely-unseen sentences count toward the unseen listening axis.

lows.item: SRS 'Review again' does location.reload() → lands on empty state
lows.evidence: Session-complete summary offers <button onclick="location.reload()">Review again</button> (srs.js:79). Every graded card has its due_date pushed to at least tomorrow (again→interval 1, good→interval≥1; db.js:316-323,369-371), so an immediate reload re-runs srsQueue() which now returns nothing due and renders 'Review complete!' (srs.js:44-53). The button almost never lets you 'review again'. It also does a full PWA reload (re-boot, re-auth via getSession timeout at app.js:84, re-fetch) instead of re-routing.
lows.fix: Either drop the button, relabel it honestly ('Back to Study' / 'Done'), or if a genuine re-run is wanted, re-render via the router (location.hash='#/srs' + route()) rather than location.reload(); it will still show the empty state but without the heavy reboot. Best: remove it and keep only 'Back to episodes'.
lows.impact: A prominent post-session CTA is misleading and triggers a costly full reload.

lows.item: Essentials KR (translation) button is 28px tall
lows.evidence: .study-x-tr is height:28px (style.css:1594). It is the per-row 'KR' reveal button used all over the Essentials list (essentials.js:101,111) and carries aria-label but a 28px tap target — well under 44px.
lows.fix: Raise the hit area to 44px (min-height:44px or vertical padding + negative margin to keep visual size). Applies wherever .study-x-tr renders.
lows.impact: Reveal-meaning taps in the list are fiddly on touch.

lows.item: SRS drag tags ('Again'/'Got it') have hardcoded light backgrounds (dark-mode contrast)
lows.evidence: .drag-tag-left/.drag-tag-right hardcode background: rgba(255,228,236,0.95) / rgba(229,245,240,0.95) (style.css:1392,1397) — light pastel — while their text/border use the theme tokens --chip-idiom-tx/--chip-coll-tx which flip to bright colors in dark mode (#FF9DBE/#5FE0C0, style.css:2162-2163). So during the stage-2 book-flip drag (srs.js:147-148), dark-mode users get bright-pink text on a light-pink background (low contrast), unlike siblings .btn.danger and .srs-pill which use adapting --chip-*-bg tokens (style.css:1206,1243-1244).
lows.fix: Replace the two hardcoded rgba backgrounds with var(--chip-idiom-bg) / var(--chip-coll-bg) so the drag tags adapt in dark mode like the grade button and pills.
lows.impact: The 'Again'/'Got it' commitment labels shown mid-swipe are hard to read in dark mode.

lows.item: SRS stage 2 shows masked hint ('c__ __') alongside the fully revealed term
lows.evidence: The listen-row with maskTerm(term) 'c__ __' renders whenever stage>=1 (srs.js:123-128), and the full term renders at stage===2 (srs.js:131). At stage 2 both appear simultaneously, so the answer card shows the masked placeholder and the real answer 'clear up' at the same time.
lows.fix: Gate the masked hint to stage===1 only (change the srs-listen-row / srs-hint-mono condition), or drop the mono hint at stage 2 and keep just the 🔊 button, so the reveal state doesn't display a now-pointless mask.
lows.impact: Momentary confusion on the answer screen; the masked hint reads as a leftover.

lows.item: SRS 'first-pass' accuracy metric mislabeled
lows.evidence: Summary shows '${acc}% first-pass' where acc = round(mastered*100/done) (srs.js:69,75). Because 'again' cards are re-queued (srs.js:254) and later graded 'good' (mastered++ at srs.js:249, done++ at 247), mastered counts retried successes and done counts every attempt. It is an overall got-it rate, not first-pass (a card failed then passed still inflates it vs a true first-attempt metric of 0 for that card).
lows.fix: Either relabel to what it measures (e.g. 'got it' / 정답률) or track a separate first-attempt counter (increment a firstPass tally only on the initial grade of each unique card id) and report that.
lows.impact: The end-of-session accuracy figure overstates first-try recall, weakening its value as a progress signal.

lows.item: SRS swipe-to-advance can skip a stage (swipe + trailing click both fire)
lows.evidence: At stage<2 the card has both card.addEventListener('click', advance) and attachSimpleSwipe(card, dir=>advance) (srs.js:186-189). advance() closes over the shared outer `let stage` and calls paint() which replaces root.innerHTML, detaching the card. On a qualifying swipe, attachSimpleSwipe fires onDir→advance (stage 0→1) synchronously; if the browser then dispatches the compatibility click for that gesture, it re-enters advance with the now-updated shared stage (1→2), skipping the audio-hint stage. Behavior is browser-dependent (the click targets a removed node), hence intermittent.
lows.fix: Guard against double-advance: mark the card consumed after the first advance (e.g. a local `advanced` flag checked at the top of advance()), or call e.preventDefault() in the swipe touchend to suppress the synthetic click, or debounce advance within one paint cycle.
lows.impact: Occasionally a swipe jumps straight to the reveal, skipping the audio/first-letter hint stage that is the point of the layered recall design.

lows.item: Back button exits PWA on a cold deep-link
lows.evidence: $back click → history.back() (app.js:235). On an episode opened as the first history entry (shared '#/episode/5' URL, or a standalone PWA launched cold to an episode), there is no prior in-app entry, so history.back() leaves the app / does nothing instead of returning to the Library. (The manifest Resume/Transcript shortcut path is safe because consumeShortcut pushes a hash after starting at '/', but direct deep links are not.)
lows.fix: In the back handler, fall back to location.hash='#/' when there is no in-app history (e.g. track a nav counter, or check history.length / a first-route flag).
lows.impact: Tapping Back from a shared episode link can eject the user from the app instead of going Home.

lows.item: Chrome copy mixes Korean into an English chrome
lows.evidence: The offline-downloads control on the Library home shows English status ('⬇ Offline: N/M ready', '⬇ Offline downloads off · tap to enable', timeline.js:89-96) but its confirmation toasts are Korean: '오프라인 저장: 최근 N개 받는 중…' / '오프라인 저장 끔' (timeline.js:110-111). Similarly the insecure-context hint toast is Korean (app.js:416 'http 접속이라 음성은…') while every other chrome toast is English ('Synced to latest', 'Dark theme', 'Offline — downloaded episodes only'). Rule: home/player chrome = English.
lows.fix: Translate these chrome toasts to English (e.g. 'Downloading latest N episodes…', 'Offline downloads off', 'Playing browser voice over http · install/https for high-quality TTS'). Keep Korean for Study/learning copy only.
lows.impact: Language rule violation on the home surface; jarring English/Korean mix in the same control.

lows.item: Theme switch touch target 28px tall (<44px)
lows.evidence: #topbar button.theme-switch is width:52px height:28px (style.css:161); the button itself is the hit area, so the vertical target is 28px. Other topbar buttons are 40x40 (style.css:146), also under the 44px guideline. Topbar is 52px tall (--topbar-h) so there is room to pad the hit area.
lows.fix: Keep the 52x28 visual but expand the button's tappable box to ≥44px tall (e.g. min-height:44px with the track centered, or vertical padding), matching iOS/Android touch-target guidance.
lows.impact: Frequent theme toggle is a small, easy-to-miss target — worse one-handed / in a car mount.

lows.item: Re-tapping the active tab does nothing (no scroll-to-top)
lows.evidence: Tabs are plain <a href='#/'> / <a href='#/study'> (index.html:98-99). route() only runs on hashchange (app.js:231), so tapping the already-active tab produces no hashchange and no action — no scroll-to-top and no reset of the current view. This is a near-universal mobile expectation, especially on the long Library list.
lows.fix: Add a click handler on tab links: if the target hash equals the current hash, scroll #app to top (and/or re-run the view). Keep default hash navigation otherwise.
lows.impact: After scrolling deep into the Library, there is no one-tap way back to the top of the list.

lows.item: Version pill (#app-version) is inert — no update/diagnostics affordance
lows.evidence: #app-version only has its textContent set ('v'+APP_VERSION, app.js:15); there is no click/keyboard handler anywhere (grep: no listener on app-version) and it is not styled as interactive (style.css:131, a static pill, hidden when logged-out). Given there is no Settings screen and updates rely on healStaleShell/controllerchange auto-reload, tapping the version to force an update-check or show diagnostics (offline run status, SW state) is an expected-but-absent affordance the task flagged.
lows.fix: Wire the version pill to a small diagnostics/update sheet (current vs available SW version, 'Check for update' → reg.update(), last offline-prefetch status from offlineRunStatus()). Cheap host for the missing Settings entry point.
lows.impact: No manual 'check for update' path; the pill looks like it should do something on a device but is dead.

lows.item: 404/unknown-hash leaves stale chrome (tab highlight, back button, _prevKey)
lows.evidence: The tab aria-current, $back.hidden, and _prevKey updates all live INSIDE the matched-route branch (app.js:36-59). The 404 fallthrough (app.js:69) renders the '404' message but never resets these, so after navigating from an episode to a bad hash the Back button stays visible and the previously-active tab stays lit; _prevKey also keeps its old value, so a subsequent episode nav mis-detects inPlace (app.js:46) and skips the spinner/fade against stale 404 DOM.
lows.fix: Before the route loop (or in the 404 branch) reset $back.hidden=true, clear all tab aria-current, and set _prevKey=null.
lows.impact: Wrong active-tab / lingering back button after a bad hash; minor render glitch on the next episode open.

lows.item: Sync ↻ on an episode shows 'Synced to latest' but skips any refresh
lows.evidence: refreshData() deliberately early-returns on episode routes to avoid re-render/listener duplication (app.js:252 'if (/^#\/episode\//… ) { done(); return; }'), but done() still fires toast('Synced to latest') after the spin (app.js:247). So on an episode the button spins and claims a sync that never happened (no refetch).
lows.fix: On the episode-skip path show a neutral/accurate toast (e.g. 'Up to date') or suppress the toast, so the confirmation isn't misleading.
lows.impact: User taps Sync during shadowing and is told it synced when nothing was refreshed.

lows.item: Login title branding inconsistent with app ('American English Podcast' vs E-Podcast)
lows.evidence:
showLogin sets the page title to 'American English Podcast' (app.js:206) and login.js:23 hardcodes

American English Podcast

, but the app brands itself 'E-Podcast' (index.html title/apple-web-app-title, manifest name) and bundles two shows — 'American English Podcast + All Ears English' (manifest.json:4). The login screen names only one of the two shows.
lows.fix: Use the app brand on login (e.g. 'E-Podcast' with a 'Shadowing Practice' subtitle) so the sign-in and in-app chrome match and don't imply a single-show app.
lows.impact: Brand mismatch at the first screen; implies the app is only American English Podcast.
